name: β-methyl-2C-B
summary: β-Methyl-2C-B (BMB), also known as 4-bromo-2,5-dimethoxy-β-methylphenethylamine, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine and 2C families related to the BOx drugs. It is the β-methyl derivative of 2C-B and a structural isomer of DOB (α-methyl-2C-B), but is less potent than either of these drugs.

pharmacology.text: It has two possible enantiomers but their activity has not been tested separately.

summaryZh: β-甲基-2C-B（英語：β-Methyl-2C-B，縮寫BMB）是一種有機化合物，化學式為C11H16BrNO2，它是布苯丙胺的同分異構體和2C-B的同系物，能作為迷幻藥物。

uses.en: It is a rare research chemical with no medical use, known from laboratory studies of 2C compounds.
uses.zh: 它是罕見的研究化學品，沒有醫療用途，僅見於 2C 類化合物的實驗室研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是罕见的研究化学品，没有医疗用途，仅见于 2C 类化合物的实验室研究。

fact.en: It is 2C-B with a methyl group added on the side chain. Adding a group at that beta position usually weakens or removes psychedelic activity, which is why these compounds interest researchers.
fact.zh: 它是在 2C-B 側鏈上加一個甲基的產物。在 β 位加上基團通常會減弱或消除迷幻活性，這正是這些化合物引起研究人員興趣的原因。
fact.zhHans: 它是在 2C-B 侧链上加一个甲基的产物。在 β 位加上基团通常会减弱或消除迷幻活性，这正是这些化合物引起研究人员兴趣的原因。
